en.headline: Government tenders Kwun Tong site for EV fast charging and LPG station
en.dek: The 5,896-square-metre lot at Wai Lok Street will replace a dedicated LPG station and support the city's EV popularisation roadmap.
body: The Government announced on Friday the sale by public tender of New Kowloon Inland Lot No. 6681 at Wai Lok Street, Kwun Tong, for an electric vehicle fast charging cum liquefied petroleum gas filling station. The site measures 5,896 square metres and the tender closes on 9 October 2026.

A spokesperson for the Environment and Ecology Bureau said the move supports the Updated Version of the Hong Kong Roadmap on Popularisation of Electric Vehicles released in February, aiming for zero vehicular emissions before 2050. The site will also reprovision the dedicated LPG filling station at Wai Lok Street to facilitate the new Vocational Training Council campus.

The retail area on the site is larger than a conventional petrol filling station, giving operators flexibility to serve EV and LPG vehicle drivers. Charging ceiling prices will apply for electric taxis and public light buses at designated stations.

zh.headline: 政府招標出售觀塘和樂街地皮作電動車快速充電及石油氣站
zh.dek: 該幅5,896平方米地皮將重置專用石油氣加氣站，並配合電動車普及化路線圖。
body: 政府星期五宣布以公開招標方式出售新九龍內地段第6681號，位於觀塘和樂街，用作電動車快速充電站兼石油氣加氣站。地盤面積5,896平方米，截標日期為2026年10月9日。
環境及生態局發言人表示，此舉支持2月公布的《香港電動車普及化路線圖》更新版，以在2050年前達致車輛零排放為目標。該地皮亦會重置和樂街專用石油氣加氣站，以配合職業訓練局新校舍發展。
地皮零售用途面積較傳統油站為大，方便營運商靈活服務電動車及石油氣車司機。指定充電站將為電動的士及公共小巴設充電上限價格。
